coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 11 ground-truth items (55%): all three required prompting methods and all three tasks. The required constants and base-10 logarithmic inference-time metric are not matched.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Specifies A100-80GB GPUs or API execution instead of an NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB GPU, and 3 runs instead of 10 repeated runs per task. Fixed random seeds and the shared framework installation/BoT repository configuration are not specified. Measures raw latency rather than log10 inference time per instance. Also adds CoT and supplementary metrics absent from the ground truth.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides neither the expected inference-time findings nor the task-specific logarithmic values, including the exception that BoT is faster than PAL on Game of 24.
